title: Integer multiplicity integrals converge under uniform convergence on a compact set carrying the carrier
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n), and K ⊆ U compact with Hⁿ(M ∖ K) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let g_j (j ∈ ℕ) and g be continuous maps ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (Covector (Euclid P) n) such that g_j → g uniformly on K. Then ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(g_j(x)) dHⁿ(x) → ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(g(x)) dHⁿ(x) as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → (∀ j, Continuous (gs j)) → Continuous g → TendstoUniformlyOn gs g atTop K → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (gs j x) ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (g x) ∂μHE[n]))
